metadata.source: Clinical Risk Stratification Framework - Educational Reference
metadata.clinical_review_status: NOT_REVIEWED - For educational, navigation, and demonstration purposes only.

risk_factors.name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
risk_factors.description: Chronically elevated arterial pressure; increases vulnerability to acute coronary syndromes and cerebral vascular events.

risk_factors.name: Diabetes Mellitus (Type 1 or Type 2)
risk_factors.description: Risk factor for atypical/silent myocardial ischemia, accelerated infections, and delayed wound healing.

risk_factors.name: Known Coronary Artery Disease / Prior Heart Attack or Stent
risk_factors.description: Established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease dramatically increases pre-test probability of recurrent ischemia.

risk_factors.name: Prior Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA)
risk_factors.description: Prior cerebrovascular event predisposes to recurrent ischemic stroke.

risk_factors.name: Asthma or Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
risk_factors.description: Baseline reactive or obstructed airway lowers threshold for respiratory failure during infections.

risk_factors.name: Blood Thinner Medication Use (Warfarin, DOACs, Clopidogrel)
risk_factors.description: Impaired hemostasis; minor trauma can cause life-threatening internal or intracranial hemorrhage.

risk_factors.name: Immunocompromised State (Chemotherapy, HIV, Organ Transplant, Biologics)
risk_factors.description: Suppressed immune system; subtle symptoms can signify fulminant systemic infection or neutropenic sepsis.

risk_factors.name: Age 65 Years or Older
risk_factors.description: Physiological reserve decline and atypical clinical presentations of major acute medical emergencies.

risk_factors.name: Current Pregnancy or Postpartum (<6 Weeks)
risk_factors.description: Hypercoagulable state with risks of pulmonary embolism, pre-eclampsia, placental abruption, and ectopic pregnancy.

risk_factors.name: Current or Significant Past Cigarette Smoking
risk_factors.description: Major risk factor for cardiovascular disease, chronic airway disease, and thromboembolism.

risk_factors.name: Major Surgery or Immobilization Within Past 4 Weeks
risk_factors.description: High Virchow's triad risk for deep vein thrombosis and fatal pulmonary embolism.

risk_factors.name: Chronic Kidney Disease or Dialysis Dependency
risk_factors.description: High susceptibility to fluid overload, hyperkalemia, accelerated atherosclerosis, and uremic pericarditis.
